definitions.en: a layer or amount that supports, softens, or protects

morphemes.note: 表层 cushion；Old French coissin 座垫。更深层可能来自 Latin coxa 臀部，也有 culcita 床垫解释，尚不唯一；不强拆 cush- + -ion。

learning.coreIdea: 一层像垫子一样的缓冲。
learning.memoryHook: a cushion of air/savings/protection.
learning.watchOut: 这里 cushion 抽象为保护层或缓冲量。
learning.notes: 表层 cushion；Old French coissin 座垫。更深层可能来自 Latin coxa 臀部，也有 culcita 床垫解释，尚不唯一；不强拆 cush- + -ion。

definitions.en: a fairly large amount

learning.memoryHook: a good deal = quite a lot.
learning.watchOut: 比 a great deal 稍弱，也可表示大量。

definitions.en: a large amount or extent

learning.memoryHook: great + deal = large amount.
learning.watchOut: 常作副词短语：matter a great deal。

definitions.en: Means 关键人物; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.memoryHook: a pivotal figure: a + pivot + al + figure → 关键人物
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: Means 一系列的东西; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.memoryHook: a range of: a + range + of → 一系列的东西
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定、重复源词或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: to leave someone or something behind or give up an effort

example.en: The team refused to abandon the project.
example.zh: 团队拒绝放弃这个项目。

definitions.en: a free or uncontrolled way of behaving

example.en: The children danced with abandon.
example.zh: 孩子们尽情地跳舞。

learning.coreIdea: 放开控制权，不再继续守住。
learning.memoryHook: abandon = give up control and leave it behind。
learning.watchOut: 注意名词 abandon 表示放纵，不等于 abandonment。

definitions.en: left and no longer used, wanted, or cared for

example.en: They found an abandoned cabin near the road.
example.zh: 他们在路边发现了一间废弃小屋。

learning.coreIdea: 被放弃后留下来的状态。
learning.memoryHook: abandoned = abandon + ed。
learning.watchOut: abandoned 可形容地点、物品或人，也可有情感色彩。

definitions.en: the act of leaving or giving something up

example.en: The plan's abandonment surprised investors.
example.zh: 这个计划被放弃让投资者感到意外。

learning.memoryHook: abandonment = the result of abandoning。
learning.watchOut: 和 abandon 的名词义“放纵”不同，abandonment 更强调抛弃/放弃。

definitions.en: to shorten a word, phrase, text, or process

example.en: Please abbreviate the title in the chart.
example.zh: 请在图表中缩写标题。

learning.memoryHook: abbreviate = make brief。
learning.watchOut: 不要和 alleviate 混淆；abbreviate 是缩短，不是减轻。

definitions.en: a shortened form of a word or phrase

example.en: NASA is an abbreviation.
example.zh: NASA 是一个缩写。

learning.memoryHook: abbreviation = the result of abbreviating。
learning.watchOut: abbreviation 指缩写形式；acronym 特指按字母读或成词的缩略词。

definitions.en: to accept and follow a rule or decision

example.en: All members must abide by the rules.
example.zh: 所有成员都必须遵守规则。

definitions.en: to tolerate or endure something

example.en: She cannot abide unfair treatment.
example.zh: 她无法忍受不公平待遇。

learning.coreIdea: 留下来承受规则或状态。
learning.memoryHook: abide by = stay with and obey。
learning.watchOut: abide 常和 by 搭配表示遵守；作“忍受”时多用于否定。

definitions.en: continuing for a long time

example.en: He has an abiding interest in history.
example.zh: 他对历史有持久的兴趣。

learning.memoryHook: abiding = remaining over time。
learning.watchOut: abiding 多修饰 interest, faith, influence 等抽象名词。

definitions.en: the power, skill, or capacity to do something

example.en: The test measures reading ability.
example.zh: 这项测试衡量阅读能力。

learning.memoryHook: ability = able + ity。
learning.watchOut: ability 泛指能力；capability 更强调可发挥的能力或性能。

definitions.en: burning, brightly lit, or shining strongly

example.en: The sky was ablaze at sunset.
example.zh: 日落时天空一片灿烂。

learning.memoryHook: ablaze = in a blaze。
learning.watchOut: ablaze 通常作表语：the room was ablaze。

definitions.en: Means 反常的，变态的; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

morphemes.meaning: away from; abnormal / 离开；反常

learning.memoryHook: abnormal: ab + norm + al → 反常的，变态的
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.zh: 在船、飞机或车上；上船/飞机/车
definitions.en: on or into a ship, aircraft, train, or bus

learning.coreIdea: 到交通工具的 board 上。
learning.memoryHook: a + board = on board.
learning.watchOut: aboard 可作副词或介词用法。

definitions.en: to officially end a law, system, or practice

example.en: The law abolished the old tax.
example.zh: 这项法律废除了旧税制。

learning.coreIdea: 把制度或做法彻底取消。
learning.memoryHook: abolish = formally do away with。
learning.watchOut: abolish 多用于制度、法律；cancel 更宽泛。

definitions.en: the act of officially ending a law, system, or practice

example.en: The abolition of the rule took years.
example.zh: 这条规则的废除花了多年。

learning.memoryHook: abolition = the act of abolishing。
learning.watchOut: 历史语境中 abolition 常特指废奴。

definitions.en: a person who worked to end slavery or supports abolishing a system

example.en: The abolitionist spoke against slavery.
example.zh: 这位废奴主义者发表演讲反对奴隶制。

learning.memoryHook: abolitionist = abolition + ist。
learning.watchOut: 最常见含义是废奴主义者，但结构上也可指支持废除某制度的人。

definitions.en: to stop a plan, process, or mission before it is completed

example.en: The crew had to abort the launch.
example.zh: 工作人员不得不中止发射。

learning.coreIdea: 在事情成形前让它停止。
learning.memoryHook: abort = stop before it fully comes into being。
learning.watchOut: 现代常作动词；Excel 中列为名词义时可理解为中止任务的行为。

definitions.en: to exist in large numbers or amounts

example.en: Wildflowers abound in the valley.
example.zh: 山谷里野花遍布。

morphemes.note: Surface stem from Latin abundare; deeper layer: ab- (away/from) + unda (wave).

learning.memoryHook: abound = overflow in quantity。
learning.watchOut: abound 常与 in/with 搭配。

definitions.en: damage caused by scraping or rubbing a surface

example.en: The helmet had signs of abrasion.
example.zh: 头盔有磨损痕迹。

learning.memoryHook: abrasion = scraping away a surface。
learning.watchOut: abrasion 是磨损结果；abrasive 是会磨损的材料或态度。

definitions.en: able to scrape surfaces, or harsh in manner

example.en: The cleaner contains abrasive particles.
example.zh: 这种清洁剂含有研磨颗粒。

learning.memoryHook: abrasive = having a scraping quality。
learning.watchOut: abrasive 也可形容人说话刺耳。

definitions.en: sudden, unexpected, or seeming rudely brief

example.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end.
example.zh: 会议突然结束了。

learning.memoryHook: abrupt = broken off suddenly。
learning.watchOut: abrupt 可指变化突然，也可指态度生硬。

definitions.en: the state of being away or not present

example.en: Her absence was noticed immediately.
example.zh: 她的缺席立刻被注意到了。

learning.memoryHook: absence = the state of being absent。
learning.watchOut: absence 可指人不在，也可指某物缺乏。

definitions.en: not present, or missing from a place or situation

example.en: Several students were absent today.
example.zh: 今天有几名学生缺席。

learning.memoryHook: absent = away from being present。
learning.watchOut: absent-minded 是心不在焉，不只是缺席。

definitions.en: a person who is not present where expected

example.en: Absentees must submit the form later.
example.zh: 缺席者必须稍后提交表格。

learning.memoryHook: absentee = one who is absent。
learning.watchOut: absentee 可用于 absentee ballot，指缺席投票相关。

definitions.en: frequent absence from school or work

example.en: The company tried to reduce absenteeism.
example.zh: 公司试图减少旷工现象。

learning.coreIdea: 缺席变成一种反复现象。
learning.memoryHook: absenteeism = the condition/practice of being absent.
learning.watchOut: absenteeism 指旷课/旷工现象，不是一次 absence。

definitions.en: complete, total, or not limited by conditions

example.en: The ruler claimed absolute power.
example.zh: 统治者声称拥有绝对权力。

learning.coreIdea: 从限制中解开，所以不受条件限制。
learning.memoryHook: absolute = loosened from conditions。
learning.watchOut: absolute 可表示完全，也可表示绝对不依赖外物。

definitions.en: completely or without qualification

example.en: You are absolutely right.
example.zh: 你完全正确。

learning.memoryHook: absolutely = in an absolute way。
learning.watchOut: 口语中 absolutely 也可表示强烈同意。

definitions.en: to take in liquid, energy, information, or attention

example.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
example.zh: 植物通过根吸收水分。

learning.memoryHook: absorb = suck in。
learning.watchOut: absorb 是吸收进入内部；adsorb 是吸附在表面。

definitions.en: the process of taking in liquid, energy, or information

example.en: The material improves sound absorption.
example.zh: 这种材料改善吸音效果。

learning.memoryHook: absorption = the process of absorbing。
learning.watchOut: 注意 absorption 和 adsorption 拼写及含义不同。

definitions.en: existing as an idea rather than a physical thing

example.en: Justice is an abstract concept.
example.zh: 正义是一个抽象概念。

definitions.en: a short summary, or to draw out the main idea

example.en: The article begins with an abstract.
example.zh: 这篇文章以摘要开头。

learning.coreIdea: 从具体事物中抽离出核心。
learning.memoryHook: abstract = draw away from the concrete。
learning.watchOut: abstract 作名词是摘要；作形容词是抽象的。

definitions.en: so unreasonable that it seems ridiculous

example.en: The claim was absurd.
example.zh: 这个说法很荒谬。

learning.coreIdea: 偏离理性到听不进去道理。
learning.memoryHook: absurd = away from reason or sense。
learning.watchOut: absurd 语气较强，常指不合逻辑到可笑。

definitions.en: a very large quantity of something

example.en: The forest provides an abundance of food.
example.zh: 森林提供大量食物。

morphemes.note: Surface stem from Latin abundare; deeper layer: ab- (away/from) + unda (wave).

learning.memoryHook: abundance = state of overflowing plenty。
learning.watchOut: an abundance of 后接不可数或复数名词。

definitions.en: available in large quantities

example.en: The region has abundant rainfall.
example.zh: 该地区雨水充沛。

morphemes.note: Surface stem from Latin abundare; deeper layer: ab- (away/from) + unda (wave).

learning.memoryHook: abundant = overflowing in amount。
learning.watchOut: abundant 常修饰 resources, evidence, rainfall。

definitions.en: in a plentiful or very clear way

example.en: The data make the point abundantly clear.
example.zh: 数据把这一点说明得非常清楚。

morphemes.note: Surface stem from Latin abundare; deeper layer: ab- (away/from) + unda (wave).

learning.coreIdea: 以丰富或非常明显的方式。
learning.memoryHook: abundantly = abundant + -ly；构词层面可看作 abund- + -ant + -ly。
learning.watchOut: abundantly clear 是常见搭配。

definitions.en: to use wrongly or treat someone cruelly

example.en: Officials must not abuse their power.
example.zh: 官员不得滥用权力。

learning.coreIdea: 偏离正常使用，或错误对待人。
learning.memoryHook: abuse = use away from the proper use。
learning.watchOut: abuse 可指滥用权力，也可指虐待。

definitions.en: to touch or border on something

example.en: The garden abuts the river.
example.zh: 花园紧邻河流。

learning.memoryHook: abut = touch at the end or border。
learning.watchOut: abut 是正式词；about 是介词/副词，拼写相近但不同。

definitions.en: related to schools, scholarship, or theoretical study

example.en: The article uses an academic style.
example.zh: 这篇文章使用学术风格。

learning.coreIdea: 与学院和学术研究有关。
learning.memoryHook: academic = related to the academy。
learning.watchOut: academic 也可表示理论上的、非实际的。

definitions.en: a member of an academy or a scholar

example.en: The academician presented new research.
example.zh: 这位院士展示了新的研究。

learning.coreIdea: 属于学术机构或学术领域的人。
learning.memoryHook: academician = academy-related person。
learning.watchOut: 在不同国家 academician 的制度含义可能不同。

definitions.en: to make something happen faster or move faster

example.en: The new policy may accelerate growth.
example.zh: 新政策可能加速增长。

learning.memoryHook: accelerate = make swift。
learning.watchOut: accelerate 可及物也可不及物。

definitions.en: made faster or occurring faster than usual

example.en: The school offers an accelerated program.
example.zh: 学校提供加速课程。

learning.memoryHook: accelerated = made faster。
learning.watchOut: accelerated program 指压缩或加快进度的课程。

definitions.en: increasing in speed or pace

example.en: They faced accelerating costs.
example.zh: 他们面临不断加速上涨的成本。

learning.memoryHook: accelerating = becoming faster。
learning.watchOut: accelerating 可修饰增长、成本、变化等。

definitions.en: an increase in speed, or the rate of that increase

example.en: The car's acceleration was impressive.
example.zh: 这辆车的加速性能令人印象深刻。

learning.coreIdea: 速度增加这个过程或程度。
learning.memoryHook: acceleration = the process/rate of speeding up。
learning.watchOut: 物理中 acceleration 指加速度；日常语境可指加快。

definitions.en: the opportunity or right to approach, enter, or use something

example.en: Students need access to reliable internet.
example.zh: 学生需要能使用可靠的互联网。

definitions.en: a way of entering or reaching a place

example.en: The building has wheelchair access.
example.zh: 这栋楼有轮椅通道。

learning.coreIdea: 走到某处并获得使用或进入机会。
learning.memoryHook: access = a way to go toward or enter。
learning.watchOut: access 是接近/使用机会；excess 是过量。

definitions.en: the quality of being easy to reach, use, understand, or obtain

example.en: The redesign improved accessibility.
example.zh: 重新设计提升了可达性。

learning.coreIdea: 容易被到达或使用的性质。
learning.memoryHook: accessibility = quality of being accessible。
learning.watchOut: 技术和建筑语境中常指无障碍性。

definitions.zh: 可接近的；可接触的；可得到的
definitions.en: easy to reach, enter, use, understand, or obtain

example.en: The museum is accessible by subway.
example.zh: 这个博物馆可以乘地铁到达。

learning.coreIdea: 可以被到达、进入或理解。
learning.memoryHook: accessible = able to be accessed。
learning.watchOut: accessible 也常表示无障碍或易懂。

definitions.en: an extra item that is useful but not essential

example.en: The case is sold as a phone accessory.
example.zh: 这个保护壳作为手机配件出售。

learning.coreIdea: 附加到主体旁边的东西。
learning.memoryHook: accessory = something that goes along with another thing。
learning.watchOut: accessory 不等于 access；法律上 accessory 也可指从犯。

definitions.en: an unexpected event, often causing damage or injury

example.en: The accident blocked the road.
example.zh: 事故堵住了道路。

learning.coreIdea: 落到人身上的意外事件。
learning.memoryHook: accident = something that happens by chance.
learning.watchOut: accident 常含损害；incident 可更中性。

definitions.en: happening by chance and not planned

example.en: The discovery was accidental.
example.zh: 这个发现是偶然的。

learning.coreIdea: 事情偶然落到某处而发生。
learning.memoryHook: accidental = happening by accident.
learning.watchOut: accidental 是偶然的；incidental 是附带的。

definitions.en: in a way that was not planned or intended

example.en: I accidentally deleted the file.
example.zh: 我不小心删除了文件。

learning.memoryHook: accidentally = in an accidental way.
learning.watchOut: 口语里可表示不小心。

definitions.en: public praise, or to praise enthusiastically

example.en: The film won critical acclaim.
example.zh: 这部电影赢得评论界赞誉。

learning.coreIdea: 把赞美声朝某人喊出来。
learning.memoryHook: acclaim = shout approval toward someone.
learning.watchOut: acclaim 是赞誉；claim 是声称或要求。

definitions.zh: 受人欢迎的；备受赞誉的
definitions.en: publicly praised and admired

example.en: She is an acclaimed scientist.
example.zh: 她是一位备受赞誉的科学家。

learning.memoryHook: acclaimed = praised with acclaim.
learning.watchOut: acclaimed 通常表示广受认可。

definitions.en: to provide space or lodging, or to adjust to fit a need

example.en: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
example.zh: 这家酒店可容纳 200 位客人。

learning.coreIdea: 把条件调到合适，能容纳或适应。
learning.memoryHook: accommodate = make suitable.
learning.watchOut: accommodate 拼写有 double c, double m。

definitions.en: willing to help or adjust to others' needs

example.en: The staff were very accommodating.
example.zh: 工作人员非常乐于帮忙。

learning.coreIdea: 愿意把条件调到适合别人。
learning.memoryHook: accommodating = willing to accommodate.
learning.watchOut: 常形容人或服务态度通融。

definitions.sense: music or thing that goes with
definitions.en: music played to support a main part, or something that goes with another thing

example.en: The piano provided the accompaniment.
example.zh: 钢琴提供了伴奏。

learning.coreIdea: 伴随主旋律或主事物的部分。
learning.memoryHook: accompaniment = something that accompanies.
learning.watchOut: 音乐中最常见是“伴奏”。

definitions.en: to go with someone or occur together with something

example.en: A guide will accompany the group.
example.zh: 一名导游将陪同这个团队。

learning.memoryHook: accompany = go in company with.
learning.watchOut: accompany 可指人陪伴，也可指音乐伴奏。

definitions.en: happening or provided together with something

example.en: Read the accompanying notes.
example.zh: 请阅读随附说明。

learning.memoryHook: accompanying = going together with.
learning.watchOut: 常用于 accompanying documents/notes。

definitions.en: to complete or achieve something successfully

example.en: We accomplished our goal.
example.zh: 我们实现了目标。

learning.memoryHook: accomplish = bring to completion.
learning.watchOut: accomplish 强调完成结果；complete 更普通。

definitions.en: highly skilled, or completed

example.en: She is an accomplished pianist.
example.zh: 她是一位技艺娴熟的钢琴家。

learning.memoryHook: accomplished = completed to a high level.
learning.watchOut: 作形容词常表示有造诣的。

definitions.en: something successfully completed or achieved

example.en: Graduation was a major accomplishment.
example.zh: 毕业是一项重大成就。

learning.memoryHook: accomplishment = result of accomplishing.
learning.watchOut: accomplishment 可指成就，也可指技能。

definitions.en: a musical instrument with bellows and keys or buttons

example.en: He played the accordion at the festival.
example.zh: 他在节日上演奏手风琴。

learning.coreIdea: 让声音像合在一起一样展开。
learning.memoryHook: accordion is built around accord/harmony.
learning.watchOut: 这是乐器名，词根教学只做辅助记忆。

definitions.en: a description or explanation of events

example.en: Her account of the trip was detailed.
example.zh: 她对旅行的叙述很详细。

definitions.en: a record of money or an arrangement for using a service

example.en: I opened a new bank account.
example.zh: 我开了一个新的银行账户。

learning.coreIdea: 把事情或数字算清楚、说明清楚。
learning.memoryHook: account = count/reckon into an explanation or record.
learning.watchOut: account for 表示解释原因。

definitions.en: a person whose job is to keep or inspect financial accounts

example.en: The accountant reviewed the records.
example.zh: 会计师审查了记录。

learning.memoryHook: accountant = person who handles accounts.
learning.watchOut: accountant 是职业名词。

definitions.en: the system or work of recording financial information

example.en: She studied accounting in college.
example.zh: 她在大学学习会计。

learning.coreIdea: 记录和核算账目的活动。
learning.memoryHook: accounting = the practice of keeping accounts.
learning.watchOut: accounting 是学科/工作；accountant 是人。

definitions.en: to officially recognize, authorize, or certify

example.en: The agency accredits universities.
example.zh: 该机构认证大学。

learning.coreIdea: 把信任正式给到某人或机构。
learning.memoryHook: accredit = give official credit/trust.
learning.watchOut: accredit 强调正式认可或授权。

definitions.en: to collect or build up gradually

example.en: Dust accumulated on the shelves.
example.zh: 灰尘在架子上积了起来。

learning.memoryHook: accumulate = gather into a heap.
learning.watchOut: 可及物也可不及物。

definitions.en: the process or result of gradually collecting

example.en: Snow accumulation slowed traffic.
example.zh: 积雪减缓了交通。

learning.coreIdea: 逐渐积起来的过程或结果。
learning.memoryHook: accumulation = result of accumulating.
learning.watchOut: 常用于物质、财富、数据等积累。

definitions.en: the quality of being correct or exact

example.en: The instrument's accuracy is high.
example.zh: 这台仪器的准确性很高。

learning.memoryHook: accuracy = quality of being accurate.
learning.watchOut: accuracy 偏正确性；precision 偏精密一致。

definitions.en: correct, exact, and free from error

example.en: The map is accurate.
example.zh: 这张地图很准确。

learning.coreIdea: 仔细照料细节，所以准确。
learning.memoryHook: accurate = done with care.
learning.watchOut: accurate 是准确；precise 是精确，二者可重叠但不完全一样。

definitions.en: a statement that someone has done something wrong

example.en: The accusation was serious.
example.zh: 这项指控很严重。

learning.memoryHook: accusation = the act/result of accusing.
learning.watchOut: accusation 是名词；accuse 是动词。

definitions.en: to say someone is responsible for a wrong act

example.en: They accused him of lying.
example.zh: 他们指责他说谎。

learning.memoryHook: accuse = point a charge toward someone.
learning.watchOut: accuse 常接 of。

definitions.en: familiar with something through repeated experience

morphemes.note: 表层 custom；Old French costume ← Latin consuetudo 习惯 ← consuescere 习惯于。深层 com-/con- 加强 + suescere 习惯于；历史压缩后的 custom 不机械按现代字母切开。

learning.memoryHook: accustomed = made used to a custom.
learning.watchOut: be accustomed to + noun/gerund。
learning.notes: 表层 custom；Old French costume ← Latin consuetudo 习惯 ← consuescere 习惯于。深层 com-/con- 加强 + suescere 习惯于；历史压缩后的 custom 不机械按现代字母切开。

definitions.en: to succeed in reaching a goal or result

example.en: She achieved her dream.
example.zh: 她实现了自己的梦想。

learning.memoryHook: achieve = bring to the desired end.
learning.watchOut: achieve 强调达成目标。

definitions.en: something important that someone has succeeded in doing

example.en: The award recognized his achievement.
example.zh: 这个奖项表彰了他的成就。

learning.coreIdea: 达成目标后留下的成果。
learning.memoryHook: achievement = result of achieving.
learning.watchOut: achievement 更强调取得的成果。

definitions.en: a sour chemical substance, or having acid qualities

example.en: Vinegar contains acid.
example.zh: 醋含有酸。

definitions.en: sharp, bitter, or harsh in speech or tone

example.en: He made an acid remark.
example.zh: 他说了一句尖酸的话。

learning.coreIdea: 味道酸，也可引申为语言尖锐。
learning.memoryHook: acid = sour/sharp.
learning.watchOut: acid 作名词是酸；作形容词可指酸的或尖酸的。

definitions.en: containing acid or having the qualities of an acid

example.en: Some soils are acidic.
example.zh: 有些土壤呈酸性。

learning.memoryHook: acidic = having acid qualities.
learning.watchOut: acidic 多用于化学、食物、土壤等。

definitions.en: the level or quality of being acidic

example.en: The test measures water acidity.
example.zh: 这项测试测量水的酸度。

learning.memoryHook: acidity = quality or level of acid.
learning.watchOut: 可指化学酸度，也可指食物酸味。

definitions.en: Means 使熟知，通知; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.memoryHook: acquaint: ac + quaint-cogn → 使熟知，通知
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定、重复源词或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: Means 相识，熟人; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.memoryHook: acquaintance: ac + quaint-cogn + ance → 相识，熟人
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定、重复源词或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: Means 有知识的，知晓的; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.memoryHook: acquainted: ac + quaint-cogn + ed → 有知识的，知晓的
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定、重复源词或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: to get, obtain, buy, or learn something

example.en: Children acquire language naturally.
example.zh: 儿童自然习得语言。

learning.memoryHook: acquire = seek and obtain.
learning.watchOut: acquire 是获得；require 是要求。

definitions.en: the act of gaining, buying, or learning something

example.en: Language acquisition takes time.
example.zh: 语言习得需要时间。

learning.coreIdea: 寻求并得到的过程或结果。
learning.memoryHook: acquisition = act/result of acquiring.
learning.watchOut: 可指收购、获得、习得。

definitions.en: a word formed from the first letters of several words

example.en: NASA is a famous acronym.
example.zh: NASA 是一个著名的首字母缩写词。

learning.memoryHook: acronym = name from beginnings.
learning.watchOut: acronym 常可读成词；initialism 通常逐字母读。

definitions.en: to make something active or start working

example.en: Press the button to activate the alarm.
example.zh: 按下按钮激活警报。

learning.memoryHook: activate = make active.
learning.watchOut: activate 比 actuate 更常用于系统、账户、功能。

definitions.en: in a way that involves action, energy, or participation

example.en: Students actively discussed the problem.
example.zh: 学生们积极讨论了这个问题。

learning.memoryHook: actively = in an active way.
learning.watchOut: active 本身未在本批 Excel 行中，后续可按需要补充。

definitions.en: real, existing in fact, or current

example.en: The actual cost was lower.
example.zh: 实际成本更低。

learning.memoryHook: actual = existing in act/fact.
learning.watchOut: actual 是实际的；virtual 是虚拟的或实质上的。

definitions.en: in fact or really

example.en: Actually, I agree with you.
example.zh: 事实上，我同意你的看法。

learning.memoryHook: actually = in actual fact.
learning.watchOut: 口语中常用于纠正或补充。

definitions.en: to make a machine or process start, or to motivate action

example.en: A sensor actuates the valve.
example.zh: 传感器启动阀门。

learning.memoryHook: actuate = cause to act.
learning.watchOut: actuate 偏机械启动或动机促使；activate 更常见。

definitions.en: quick, sharp judgment or insight

example.en: Her business acumen impressed investors.
example.zh: 她的商业敏锐度给投资者留下深刻印象。

learning.memoryHook: acumen = mental sharpness.
learning.watchOut: 常见搭配 business acumen。

definitions.en: Means 针刺；针灸; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

morphemes.meaning: state or thing / 状态；事物

learning.memoryHook: acupuncture: acu + punct + ure → 针刺；针灸
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定、重复源词或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: very sharp, keen, or perceptive

example.en: Dogs have an acute sense of smell.
example.zh: 狗有敏锐的嗅觉。

definitions.en: severe, intense, or needing urgent attention

example.en: The patient felt acute pain.
example.zh: 病人感到剧烈疼痛。

learning.coreIdea: 像尖端一样锐利，也可指程度强烈。
learning.memoryHook: acute = sharp, keen, intense.
learning.watchOut: 医学中 acute 常和 chronic 对比：急性的 vs 慢性的。

definitions.en: to change something, or change yourself, so it fits a new situation or purpose

example.en: Animals adapt to dry climates in different ways.
example.zh: 动物以不同方式适应干旱气候。

learning.coreIdea: 把自己或事物调到合适的位置。
learning.memoryHook: adapt = ad + apt：朝合适的状态靠过去。
learning.watchOut: adapt 强调适应或改编；adopt 是采纳/收养。

definitions.zh: 能适应的；适应能力强的
definitions.en: able to change easily to fit new conditions

example.en: An adaptable team can work under pressure.
example.zh: 适应力强的团队能在压力下工作。

learning.memoryHook: adaptable = able to adapt.
learning.watchOut: adaptable 描述人、系统或物种的适应能力。

definitions.en: a change that helps something fit its environment or situation

example.en: Thick fur is an adaptation to cold weather.
example.zh: 厚毛是对寒冷天气的一种适应。

definitions.en: a version of a book, film, or work changed for a new form or audience

example.en: The film is an adaptation of a novel.
example.zh: 这部电影是小说改编作品。

learning.coreIdea: 为了适合而产生的变化或改写结果。
learning.memoryHook: adaptation = the result of adapting.
learning.watchOut: 生物学里常指适应性特征；文学影视里常指改编作品。

definitions.en: helping something adjust to conditions or changing as conditions change

example.en: Adaptive technology changes with user needs.
example.zh: 自适应技术会随用户需求改变。

learning.memoryHook: adaptive = tending to adapt.
learning.watchOut: adaptive 多修饰 behavior, system, strategy。

definitions.en: more than what already exists or has been mentioned

example.en: The project needs additional funding.
example.zh: 这个项目需要额外资金。

learning.coreIdea: 在已有内容之外再加上的。
learning.memoryHook: additional = added on.
learning.watchOut: additional 是形容词；in addition to 是介词短语。

definitions.en: a substance added to another substance, often to improve or preserve it

example.en: Some foods contain color additives.
example.zh: 一些食物含有色素添加剂。

definitions.en: relating to addition or produced by adding parts

example.en: The model assumes an additive effect.
example.zh: 这个模型假设存在累加效应。

learning.coreIdea: 被加进去的东西，或通过相加产生的性质。
learning.memoryHook: additive = something added.
learning.watchOut: 作名词常指食品、化学品里的添加剂。

definitions.en: very skilled at doing something, or a person who has such skill

morphemes.note: 保留 apt 与 ept 的历史相关性但区分路径：adapt 来自 aptare 使适合；adept = ad- + ept-，来自 adipisci 的分词 adeptus，底层 apisci 抓住、达到。不能把 adept 解释成给适合加前缀。

learning.memoryHook: adept = one who has attained skill.
learning.watchOut: 常用 adept at；不要写成 adapt。
learning.notes: 保留 apt 与 ept 的历史相关性但区分路径：adapt 来自 aptare 使适合；adept = ad- + ept-，来自 adipisci 的分词 adeptus，底层 apisci 抓住、达到。不能把 adept 解释成给适合加前缀。

definitions.en: good enough or sufficient for a particular need

example.en: The shelter provides adequate protection.
example.zh: 这个避难所提供足够保护。

learning.memoryHook: adequate = equal to what is required.
learning.watchOut: adequate 有时只是“够用”，不一定表示优秀。

definitions.en: to stick firmly to a surface

example.en: The label did not adhere to the bottle.
example.zh: 标签没有粘牢在瓶子上。

definitions.en: to follow a rule, belief, or plan closely

example.en: Researchers must adhere to ethical standards.
example.zh: 研究人员必须遵守伦理标准。

learning.coreIdea: 牢牢贴在表面或原则上。
learning.memoryHook: adhere = stick to.
learning.watchOut: adhere to 可表示物理粘附，也可表示遵守规则。

definitions.en: a substance that makes things stick together

example.en: The carpenter used a strong adhesive.
example.zh: 木匠使用了强力胶黏剂。

definitions.en: able to stick to a surface

example.en: Adhesive tape sealed the box.
example.zh: 胶带封住了盒子。

learning.coreIdea: 具有让东西粘住的性质。
learning.memoryHook: adhesive = something that adheres.
learning.watchOut: 作名词是胶黏剂；作形容词是有粘性的。

definitions.en: near or next to something, often sharing a border

example.en: The library is adjacent to the science building.
example.zh: 图书馆紧邻科学楼。

learning.memoryHook: adjacent = lying next to.
learning.watchOut: adjacent 不一定接触；adjoining 更强调相接。

definitions.en: to be next to and usually touching another place or thing

example.en: The garden adjoins the museum.
example.zh: 花园与博物馆相邻。

learning.memoryHook: adjoin = join to.
learning.watchOut: adjoin 常表示地块、房间、建筑相接。

definitions.en: next to and connected with something

example.en: They booked adjoining rooms.
example.zh: 他们订了相邻连通的房间。

learning.memoryHook: adjoining rooms share a join.
learning.watchOut: adjacent rooms may simply be nearby; adjoining rooms normally touch or connect.

definitions.en: something added to another thing but not an essential part of it

example.en: The lab is an adjunct to the main course.
example.zh: 实验课是主课的附属部分。

learning.coreIdea: 接到主体旁边的附属部分。
learning.memoryHook: adjunct = joined-on extra.
learning.watchOut: adjunct professor 是兼职/附属职位，不等于 assistant professor。

definitions.en: to change something slightly so it works better or fits a situation

example.en: Adjust the microscope before recording data.
example.zh: 记录数据前先调整显微镜。

morphemes.note: Historically from Late Latin adiuxtare 'bring near'; later influenced by just.

learning.coreIdea: 把部件调近到合适的位置。
learning.memoryHook: adjust = move toward a proper fit.
learning.watchOut: adjust 可指微调；adapt 更偏适应新环境。

definitions.en: a small change made so something fits or works better

example.en: A minor adjustment improved the results.
example.zh: 一次小调整改善了结果。

learning.coreIdea: 为了合适而做出的改变。
learning.memoryHook: adjustment = result of adjusting.
learning.watchOut: 可数时指一次具体调整；不可数时可指适应过程。

definitions.en: to manage, direct, or give something officially

example.en: Nurses administer the vaccine carefully.
example.zh: 护士小心施用疫苗。

learning.coreIdea: 以服务者/管理者身份执行事务。
learning.memoryHook: administer = manage as a ministering servant.
learning.watchOut: administer medicine 是给药；administer a program 是管理项目。

definitions.en: the act or system of managing an organization, program, or rule

example.en: The administration of the grant required careful records.
example.zh: 这笔资助的管理需要仔细记录。

definitions.en: the group of people who manage a government, school, or organization

example.en: The administration announced a new policy.
example.zh: 政府宣布了一项新政策。

learning.coreIdea: 执行管理的过程或管理者群体。
learning.memoryHook: administration = the system that administers.
learning.watchOut: 可指管理行为，也可指政府/校方等管理机构。

definitions.en: relating to the work of managing an organization or office

example.en: Administrative tasks delayed the research.
example.zh: 行政事务耽误了研究。

learning.memoryHook: administrative = relating to administration.
learning.watchOut: administrative work 通常指办公室/组织管理事务。

definitions.en: a person who manages an organization, system, or program

example.en: The administrator updated the database.
example.zh: 管理员更新了数据库。

learning.memoryHook: administrator = one who administers.
learning.watchOut: 在计算机语境中常指系统管理员或管理员权限。

definitions.en: a feeling of respect, approval, or pleasure

example.en: The discovery filled them with admiration.
example.zh: 这项发现让他们充满赞叹。

learning.memoryHook: admiration = the feeling of admiring.
learning.watchOut: admiration for someone/something 是常见搭配。

definitions.en: to respect, like, or look at someone or something with pleasure

example.en: Many students admire her courage.
example.zh: 许多学生钦佩她的勇气。

learning.coreIdea: 把目光和惊叹投向某人/某物。
learning.memoryHook: admire = look toward with wonder.
learning.watchOut: admire 可表示钦佩，也可表示欣赏景色或作品。

definitions.en: to allow someone to enter a place, group, or institution

example.en: The university admitted more international students.
example.zh: 这所大学录取了更多国际学生。

definitions.en: to accept that something is true, often unwillingly

example.en: He admitted that the estimate was wrong.
example.zh: 他承认估算错了。

learning.memoryHook: admit = send/let into acceptance.
learning.watchOut: admit doing something；admit that...；admit to a place。

definitions.zh: 公认地；诚然；无可否认地
definitions.en: used to introduce something true, often before a contrast

example.en: Admittedly, the plan is expensive, but it is effective.
example.zh: 诚然，这个计划很贵，但它有效。

learning.coreIdea: 先承认某点，再继续说明。
learning.memoryHook: admittedly = it is admitted that...
learning.watchOut: 常放句首，引出让步：Admittedly, ..., but ...

definitions.en: a sun-dried brick made of clay or earth, or the material used to make it

example.en: The old house was built from adobe.
example.zh: 这栋老房子由土坯建成。

learning.memoryHook: adobe = earth made into brick.
learning.watchOut: Adobe 首字母大写时也可指公司名；这里是普通名词。

definitions.en: Means 青少年; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.memoryHook: adolescent: adolesc + ent → 青少年
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；大小写同形、来源不稳定或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: to choose and begin to use an idea, method, or policy

example.en: The lab adopted a new protocol.
example.zh: 实验室采用了新规程。

definitions.en: to legally take another person's child into one's family

example.en: They adopted a child last year.
example.zh: 他们去年收养了一个孩子。

learning.coreIdea: 选择某物并把它变成自己的。
learning.memoryHook: adopt = opt/choose for oneself.
learning.watchOut: adopt 是采纳/收养；adapt 是适应/改编。

definitions.en: the act of choosing a method or legally taking a child into a family

example.en: The adoption of solar power reduced costs.
example.zh: 太阳能的采用降低了成本。

learning.coreIdea: 把选择落实成采纳或收养的行为。
learning.memoryHook: adoption = the act of adopting.
learning.watchOut: technology adoption 指技术采用；child adoption 指收养。

definitions.en: to decorate or add beauty to something

example.en: Paintings adorn the hallway.
example.zh: 画作装饰着走廊。

learning.coreIdea: 给事物加上装饰，使其更有秩序和美感。
learning.memoryHook: adorn = add ornament.
learning.watchOut: 常用于较正式或书面语境。

definitions.en: decoration, or something used for decoration

example.en: The vase needed no adornment.
example.zh: 这个花瓶无需装饰。

learning.coreIdea: 装饰出来的结果或装饰物本身。
learning.memoryHook: adornment = something that adorns.
learning.watchOut: 可以抽象指装饰，也可以具体指装饰品。

definitions.en: to move forward, improve, or help something develop

example.en: New tools advance medical research.
example.zh: 新工具推动医学研究发展。

definitions.en: to present an idea, argument, or proposal

example.en: The article advances a new theory.
example.zh: 这篇文章提出了一个新理论。

definitions.en: a forward movement, improvement, or payment made before it is due

example.en: They paid an advance before construction began.
example.zh: 施工开始前他们支付了预付款。

morphemes.note: From Late Latin abante 'from before'; the d is unetymological.

learning.coreIdea: 向前推进到更靠前的位置。
learning.memoryHook: advance = move to the front.
learning.watchOut: in advance 表示预先；advance 也可作动词或名词。

definitions.en: far ahead in development, difficulty, or age

example.en: The course covers advanced biology.
example.zh: 这门课讲授高级生物学。

learning.coreIdea: 已经推进到更前、更高或更晚阶段。
learning.memoryHook: advanced = moved ahead.
learning.watchOut: advanced age 指高龄；advanced technology 指先进技术。

definitions.en: progress, improvement, or promotion to a higher position

example.en: Scientific advancement depends on shared evidence.
example.zh: 科学进步依赖共享证据。

learning.coreIdea: 向前推进产生的进展或提升。
learning.memoryHook: advancement = result of advancing.
learning.watchOut: career advancement 常指职业晋升。

definitions.en: the arrival or beginning of an important event, period, or invention

example.en: The advent of satellites changed communication.
example.zh: 卫星的出现改变了通信。

learning.coreIdea: 某个重要事物来到眼前。
learning.memoryHook: advent = arrival that comes toward us.
learning.watchOut: 常见搭配 the advent of technology/printing/the internet。

definitions.en: Means 冒险，冒险的经历; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

morphemes.note: Conservative bottom root inside this learner-visible analysis; deeper source is uncertain or not productive for TOEFL study.

learning.memoryHook: adventure: ad + venture → 冒险，冒险的经历
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按 skill 的可见学习结构处理；能拆的复合词、前后缀和同族词已拆到底层教学单位，来源不稳定或不适合继续拆的词保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: a person who seeks exciting or risky experiences

example.en: The adventurer crossed the desert alone.
example.zh: 那位冒险家独自穿越沙漠。

learning.coreIdea: 主动寻找冒险经历的人。
learning.memoryHook: adventurer = one who adventures.
learning.watchOut: 有时可带负面含义，指投机冒险者。

definitions.zh: 喜欢冒险的；敢做敢为的
definitions.en: willing to try new, difficult, or risky things

example.en: An adventurous scientist tested the new method.
example.zh: 一位敢于冒险的科学家测试了新方法。

learning.memoryHook: adventurous = full of adventure.
learning.watchOut: 可形容人，也可形容计划、旅行、选择。

definitions.en: Means 不利的；敌对的；相反地; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.memoryHook: adverse: ad + vers → 不利的；敌对的；相反地
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按 skill 的可见学习结构处理；能拆的复合词、前后缀和同族词已拆到底层教学单位，来源不稳定或不适合继续拆的词保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: in a way that harms, opposes, or has a negative effect

example.en: Noise can adversely affect sleep.
example.zh: 噪音会对睡眠产生不利影响。

learning.coreIdea: 以不利、相反的方式发生。
learning.memoryHook: adversely = in an adverse way.
learning.watchOut: 常见搭配 adversely affect。

definitions.en: difficulty, misfortune, or hardship

example.en: The community showed strength in adversity.
example.zh: 这个社区在逆境中展现力量。

learning.coreIdea: 不利之事转向自己时形成的困境。
learning.memoryHook: adversity = adverse state.
learning.watchOut: adversity 强调困境/逆境，不只是一个 negative effect。

definitions.en: a person who publicly supports or recommends a cause, policy, or person

example.en: She is an advocate for clean water.
example.zh: 她是清洁用水的倡导者。

definitions.en: to publicly support or recommend an idea or action

example.en: The report advocates stronger protections.
example.zh: 报告主张采取更强保护措施。

learning.coreIdea: 用声音站出来支持某事。
learning.memoryHook: advocate = call toward support.
learning.watchOut: 作名词读音重音常在首音节；作动词常表示公开支持。

definitions.sense: the study of moving air and its effects on objects
definitions.en: the study of moving air and its effects on objects

morphemes.note: Ultimate origin is uncertain; the learner-facing source is Greek/Latin aer.

morphemes.meaning: power, be able / 力量；能够
morphemes.note: dynamis 为 dynasthai 能够的名词派生，含 m 扩展；更深来源未定，不能拆 dy- 为二。

morphemes.meaning: field of study or practice / 学科；实践领域
morphemes.note: -ics 为学科名词结尾，深层 -ic 相关 + -s 名词化/复数形式；词法功能不等于数个对象。

definitions.en: relating to beauty, art, taste, or the perception of beauty

example.en: The building has a simple aesthetic style.
example.zh: 这栋建筑有简洁的审美风格。

learning.coreIdea: 通过感官感知美和形式。
learning.memoryHook: aesthetic begins with sense perception, then taste.
learning.watchOut: aesthetic 是审美/美学；ascetic 是苦行的。

definitions.en: to influence or produce a change in someone or something

example.en: Temperature affects reaction speed.
example.zh: 温度会影响反应速度。

definitions.en: to pretend to have a feeling, style, or quality

example.en: He affected a calm voice.
example.zh: 他装出平静的语气。

learning.coreIdea: 对某物做作用，从而影响它。
learning.memoryHook: affect = act on.
learning.watchOut: affect 通常是动词“影响”；effect 常作名词“结果/影响”。

definitions.en: not natural or sincere; deliberately displayed

example.en: Her affected accent sounded unnatural.
example.zh: 她装出来的口音听起来不自然。

learning.memoryHook: affected = made-up manner.
learning.watchOut: affected 作形容词可指“受影响的”，也可指“做作的”；本批强调后者。

definitions.en: a gentle feeling of liking, love, or fondness

example.en: Children need affection and security.
example.zh: 孩子需要关爱和安全感。

learning.coreIdea: 内心被某人某物影响后形成的温情。
learning.memoryHook: affection = a feeling that affects the heart.
learning.watchOut: affection 通常是温情；infection 是感染，拼写相近但来源不同前缀。

definitions.en: showing love, fondness, or warm feeling

example.en: The child gave an affectionate smile.
example.zh: 孩子露出亲切的微笑。

learning.memoryHook: affectionate = full of affection.
learning.watchOut: 常修饰 person, smile, gesture, relationship。

definitions.en: relating to emotions, feelings, or moods

example.en: The study measured affective responses.
example.zh: 该研究测量了情感反应。

learning.coreIdea: 与感情如何被影响有关。
learning.memoryHook: affective = about affect/feeling.
learning.watchOut: affective 是情感的；effective 是有效的。

definitions.en: to connect a person or organization officially with a larger group

example.en: The clinic is affiliated with the university.
example.zh: 这家诊所隶属于该大学。

learning.coreIdea: 像把孩子接入家族一样接入组织。
learning.memoryHook: affiliate = attach as a member of the family.
learning.watchOut: 常用被动 be affiliated with。

definitions.en: a natural connection, similarity, or close relationship

example.en: The two languages have a strong affinity.
example.zh: 这两种语言有很强的亲缘关系。

definitions.en: a natural liking for or attraction to someone or something

example.en: She has an affinity for music.
example.zh: 她天生喜欢音乐。

learning.coreIdea: 边界相邻，关系因此接近。
learning.memoryHook: affinity = bordering-on closeness.
learning.watchOut: affinity for 表示对某物天然喜爱；affinity with 表示相似或亲缘关系。

definitions.en: to state strongly that something is true or to confirm it

example.en: The witness affirmed the facts.
example.zh: 证人确认了事实。

learning.memoryHook: affirm = make firm in words.
learning.watchOut: affirm 比 say 更正式，常用于声明、判决、信念。

definitions.en: Means （外来到）折磨; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

morphemes.note: Reviewed surface piece; deeper source is shown on root root:af.
Reviewed surface piece; deeper source is shown on root root:flict.

learning.memoryHook: Reviewed in the 2401-2600 pass: visible morphemes are split where useful; one-piece items are retained only as conservative bottom roots.
learning.watchOut: Historical uncertainties and source-spelling issues are documented in the batch report when relevant.

definitions.en: pain, suffering, or a cause of continuing trouble

example.en: The disease became a lifelong affliction.
example.zh: 这种疾病成了终身折磨。

learning.coreIdea: 被打击后承受的痛苦状态。
learning.memoryHook: affliction = state of being afflicted.
learning.watchOut: affliction 指苦难；infliction 指施加某种痛苦的行为。

definitions.en: having a lot of money, resources, or abundance

example.en: Affluent neighborhoods often have more services.
example.zh: 富裕社区通常拥有更多服务。

learning.coreIdea: 财富或资源不断流向某处。
learning.memoryHook: affluent = resources flowing toward you.
learning.watchOut: affluent 常指富裕人群或地区；fluent 是说话流利。

definitions.en: to have enough money, time, or resources for something

example.en: The family could not afford the repair.
example.zh: 这家人负担不起维修费用。

definitions.en: to provide or give an opportunity, view, or protection

example.en: The hill affords a clear view.
example.zh: 这座山丘提供了清晰视野。

morphemes.note: Modern spelling has aff-, but the word is Germanic rather than Latin ad-.

learning.coreIdea: 把资源拿得出来，所以能负担或提供。
learning.memoryHook: afford = put forth what is needed.
learning.watchOut: afford to do 表示有能力/负担得起做某事；afford something 可表示提供机会或视野。

definitions.en: cheap enough for people to be able to pay for

example.en: The city needs affordable housing.
example.zh: 这座城市需要可负担住房。

learning.coreIdea: 价格低到资源拿得出来。
learning.memoryHook: affordable = able to be afforded.
learning.watchOut: affordable 不一定等于 cheap；重点是“能负担”。

definitions.en: a list of things to be discussed or done

example.en: Climate policy is high on the agenda.
example.zh: 气候政策是议程上的重点。

morphemes.note: Latin gerundive plural idea: agenda = things to be done.

learning.memoryHook: agenda = things to be done.
learning.watchOut: agenda 形式像复数，但现代英语常作单数集合名词。

definitions.en: to make a bad situation, illness, or problem worse

example.en: Smoke can aggravate asthma.
example.zh: 烟雾会加重哮喘。

learning.coreIdea: 给问题再加重量，使它更严重。
learning.memoryHook: aggravate = make heavier.
learning.watchOut: 正式意义是“使恶化”；口语里也可指“惹恼”。

definitions.en: annoying, or making a bad situation worse

example.en: The delay was aggravating.
example.zh: 延误令人恼火。

learning.coreIdea: 让问题或心情变得更沉重。
learning.memoryHook: aggravating = causing aggravation.
learning.watchOut: aggravating circumstances 指加重情节，不只是烦人。

definitions.en: a total formed by adding separate amounts together

example.en: The aggregate score decided the winner.
example.zh: 总分决定了获胜者。

definitions.en: a mass or group made of many separate parts

example.en: Sandstone is an aggregate of mineral grains.
example.zh: 砂岩是矿物颗粒的集合体。

learning.coreIdea: 把分散个体聚成一群或一个总量。
learning.memoryHook: aggregate = gather into a flock.
learning.watchOut: 作名词是总数/集合体；作动词也可表示汇总。

definitions.en: the act or result of gathering separate things into a group or total

example.en: Data aggregation can hide local differences.
example.zh: 数据汇总可能掩盖局部差异。

learning.coreIdea: 聚集成群或总量的过程/结果。
learning.memoryHook: aggregation = the result of aggregating.
learning.watchOut: aggregation 强调汇总过程；aggregate 可作总数或集合体。

definitions.en: forceful, determined, and energetic

example.en: The company followed an aggressive growth strategy.
example.zh: 公司采取了积极强势的增长策略。

definitions.en: ready to attack or behave in a hostile way

example.en: The animal became aggressive when threatened.
example.zh: 动物受到威胁时变得有攻击性。

learning.coreIdea: 主动向前迈步，甚至带攻击性。
learning.memoryHook: aggressive = stepping toward first.
learning.watchOut: 可正面表示进取，也可负面表示好斗。

definitions.en: the quality of being forceful, determined, or ready to attack

example.en: Excessive aggressiveness can damage cooperation.
example.zh: 过度强势会破坏合作。

learning.coreIdea: 向前压迫或攻击的性质。
learning.memoryHook: aggressiveness = the quality of being aggressive.
learning.watchOut: 可以指行为攻击性，也可以指商业策略的强势。

definitions.en: able to move or think quickly and easily

example.en: An agile mind adapts to new evidence.
example.zh: 敏捷的头脑能适应新证据。

learning.coreIdea: 动作或思维容易被驱动起来。
learning.memoryHook: agile = easily set in motion.
learning.watchOut: agile 可形容身体敏捷，也可形容思维或团队灵活。

definitions.en: the ability to move, think, or respond quickly and easily

example.en: Market agility helped the firm survive.
example.zh: 市场敏捷性帮助公司存活下来。

learning.memoryHook: agility = agile quality.
learning.watchOut: 在商业或软件语境中也可指组织灵活性。

definitions.en: a state of nervous excitement or worry

example.en: The announcement caused public agitation.
example.zh: 公告引发了公众不安。

definitions.en: the act of stirring people up around an issue

example.en: Political agitation spread through the city.
example.zh: 政治鼓动在城中蔓延。

learning.coreIdea: 身心或人群被来回搅动。
learning.memoryHook: agitation = motion tossed to and fro.
learning.watchOut: 既可指内心焦躁，也可指政治/社会煽动。

definitions.en: pleasant, satisfactory, or acceptable

example.en: The climate is agreeable in spring.
example.zh: 春天的气候令人愉快。

definitions.en: pleasant and willing to cooperate

example.en: He is agreeable in group work.
example.zh: 他在小组工作中很好相处。

learning.coreIdea: 让人愿意赞同或感到舒服。
learning.memoryHook: agreeable = pleasing enough to agree with.
learning.watchOut: agreeable person 是好相处的人；agreeable idea 是令人接受的想法。

definitions.en: the science or practice of farming and cultivating land

morphemes.note: 表层 cult-/cultiv-；Latin colere 耕作、照料的分词 cultus 提供 cult-。culture = cult- + -ure；cultivate 的 cultiv- 来自 Medieval Latin cultivare，关联 Late Latin cultivus 耕作的，较深层 cult- + 形容词 -iv-。

morphemes.meaning: cultivate, care, culture / 耕作；培养；文化
act or result / 行为；结果

learning.coreIdea: 对 field 和土地进行 cultivation。
learning.memoryHook: ager = field + culture = cultivation.
learning.watchOut: agriculture 是广义农业。
learning.notes: 表层 cult-/cultiv-；Latin colere 耕作、照料的分词 cultus 提供 cult-。culture = cult- + -ure；cultivate 的 cultiv- 来自 Medieval Latin cultivare，关联 Late Latin cultivus 耕作的，较深层 cult- + 形容词 -iv-。

definitions.en: a minor illness or health problem

example.en: Rest helped the minor ailment improve.
example.zh: 休息帮助这点小病好转。

learning.memoryHook: ailment = what ails you.
learning.watchOut: ailment 通常比 disease 轻或范围更局部。

definitions.en: a purpose or goal

example.en: The aim of the study is to compare habitats.
example.zh: 这项研究的目标是比较栖息地。

definitions.en: to direct something at a target or intend to do something

example.en: The policy aims to reduce waste.
example.zh: 该政策旨在减少浪费。

learning.coreIdea: 先估准目标，再把行动指向它。
learning.memoryHook: aim grew from estimating to directing at a target.
learning.watchOut: aim at + 名词/动名词；aim to do 表示打算做。

definitions.en: the invisible gases around the earth, or the space above the ground

example.en: Warm air rises.
example.zh: 暖空气会上升。

definitions.en: to expose something to fresh air or make a room ventilated

example.en: Open the windows to air the room.
example.zh: 打开窗户给房间通风。

learning.coreIdea: 围绕和流动在空间中的空气。
learning.memoryHook: air = the atmosphere around us.
learning.watchOut: air 作动词可指通风；on the air 指广播中。

definitions.en: a machine that cools and dries indoor air

learning.memoryHook: air + conditioner.
learning.watchOut: 常缩写为 AC 或 A/C。

definitions.en: a vehicle supported by a cushion of air

morphemes.note:
表层 cushion；Old French coissin 座垫。更深层可能来自 Latin coxa 臀部，也有 culcita 床垫解释，尚不唯一；不强拆 cush- + -ion。
表层 vehicle；Latin vehiculum 运输工具 ← vehere 运载 + 工具名词结尾 -culum。短语 air-cushion vehicle 内保留 vehicle，但同时解释 veh- 运载与 -icle 历史工具结尾。

learning.coreIdea: 由空气垫托起的交通工具。
learning.memoryHook: air + cushion + vehicle.
learning.watchOut: 与 hovercraft 同义或近义，强调 air cushion 的结构。
learning.notes:
表层 cushion；Old French coissin 座垫。更深层可能来自 Latin coxa 臀部，也有 culcita 床垫解释，尚不唯一；不强拆 cush- + -ion。
表层 vehicle；Latin vehiculum 运输工具 ← vehere 运载 + 工具名词结尾 -culum。短语 air-cushion vehicle 内保留 vehicle，但同时解释 veh- 运载与 -icle 历史工具结尾。

definitions.zh: 空气传播的；空运的；空降的
definitions.en: carried through the air or transported by aircraft

example.en: Airborne pollen can trigger allergies.
example.zh: 空气传播的花粉会引发过敏。

learning.memoryHook: airborne = borne by air.
learning.watchOut: airborne disease 是空气传播疾病；airborne troops 是空降部队。

definitions.en: Means 航行器; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.memoryHook: aircraft: air + craft → 航行器
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定、重复源词或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: Means 晕机; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.memoryHook: airsickness: air + sick + ness → 晕机
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按 skill 的可见学习结构处理；能拆的复合词、前后缀和同族词已拆到底层教学单位，来源不稳定或不适合继续拆的词保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: Means （门窗等）微开的; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

morphemes.note: Reviewed surface piece; source/deeper layer shown on root root:a.
Reviewed surface piece; source/deeper layer shown on root root:jar.

learning.memoryHook: Reviewed in the 2601-2800 pass: visible morphemes are split where useful; one-piece items are retained only as conservative bottom roots.
learning.watchOut: Potential source spelling issues and conservative etymology choices are documented in the batch report.

definitions.en: related by nature, origin, or character; similar

example.en: The method is akin to natural selection.
example.zh: 这种方法类似于自然选择。

learning.coreIdea: 属于同一亲族或同一种类。
learning.memoryHook: akin = of kin.
learning.watchOut: 常用 akin to，表示“类似于”。

definitions.en: a medieval practice that tried to transform metals, especially into gold

example.en: Alchemy helped shape early chemistry.
example.zh: 炼金术推动了早期化学的发展。

morphemes.note: Arabic definite article in this borrowed word.

learning.coreIdea: 试图把物质神秘转化的早期化学。
learning.memoryHook: alchemy = the old art behind chemistry.
learning.watchOut: 现代多指中世纪炼金术，也可比喻神奇转化。

definitions.en: a tree related to the birch that often grows in wet ground

example.en: Alders grew along the stream.
example.zh: 溪边长着赤杨树。

learning.coreIdea: 湿地附近常见的一种树。
learning.memoryHook: alder = a water-loving tree.
learning.watchOut: alder 是树；elder 可指年长者或接骨木。

definitions.en: watchful, ready to notice danger or act quickly

example.en: The guard remained alert all night.
example.zh: 守卫整夜保持警觉。

definitions.en: to warn someone about danger or important information

example.en: The system alerts users to errors.
example.zh: 系统提醒用户注意错误。

definitions.en: a warning signal or state of watchfulness

example.en: The city issued a storm alert.
example.zh: 城市发布了风暴警报。

learning.coreIdea: 像站上高处放哨一样保持警觉。
learning.memoryHook: alert = on the lookout.
learning.watchOut: alert 作形容词是警觉的；作动词是提醒；作名词是警报。

definitions.en: simple plant-like organisms that live in water or damp places

example.en: Algae grew on the surface of the pond.
example.zh: 藻类长在池塘表面。

learning.coreIdea: 在水中或潮湿处生长的简单藻类。
learning.memoryHook: algae = water-growing green life.
learning.watchOut: algae 是复数或集合用法；单数是 alga，但日常多见 algae。

definitions.en: different from what is familiar or belonging to another place

learning.memoryHook: alien = from the other side.
learning.watchOut: alien 可指外国的、陌生的，也可在科幻里指外星的。

definitions.en: arrangement in a straight line or proper position
agreement or cooperation among people or groups

learning.coreIdea: 把东西放到同一条线上，引申为立场一致。
learning.memoryHook: alignment = put in line.
learning.watchOut: alignment 可指物理排齐，也可指组织/观点一致。

definitions.en: similar to each other
in the same or similar way

learning.memoryHook: alike = in like form.
learning.watchOut: alike 常作表语或副词：look alike / treat them alike。

definitions.en: almost completely
all except the thing or person named

learning.coreIdea: 整体里只把一点排除在外，所以也可表示“几乎全部”。
learning.memoryHook: all but = all except a tiny remainder.
learning.watchOut: 后接形容词时常是“几乎”；后接名词时常是“除……以外”。

definitions.en: including all costs, parts, or people

learning.coreIdea: 把所有东西都关进同一个范围里。
learning.memoryHook: all-inclusive = everything included inside.
learning.watchOut: 常用连字符写作 all-inclusive；注意 inclusive 本身是形容词。

definitions.en: a claim, especially one not yet proved

learning.coreIdea: 把一个正式说法推到别人面前。
learning.memoryHook: allegation = an alleged claim.
learning.watchOut: allegation 是未经完全证实的说法/指控，不要和 allegory 混。

definitions.en: a story or picture whose surface events stand for deeper meanings

morphemes.note: From Greek agoreuein, to speak publicly.

learning.coreIdea: 用“另一层话”公开讲真正的意思。
learning.memoryHook: allegory = other-speaking story.
learning.watchOut: 不要把 allegory 和 allegation 混。

definitions.en: repetition of the same initial sound or letter in nearby words

learning.coreIdea: 让多个词都朝向同一个开头字母。
learning.memoryHook: alliteration = letters lining up at the beginning.
learning.watchOut: 这是修辞/诗歌术语，不是 allegation 或 allegory。

definitions.en: to set apart or assign for a particular purpose

learning.memoryHook: allocate = place toward a purpose.
learning.watchOut: allocate 强调正式分配资源；不要和 locate “定位”混。

definitions.en: a metal made by combining metallic elements
to mix a metal with another substance

learning.coreIdea: 把不同金属绑在一起成为一种材料。
learning.memoryHook: alloy = metals allied together.
learning.watchOut: alloy 是合金；ally 是盟友/结盟，词义不同但同根相邻。

definitions.en: to refer to something indirectly

learning.coreIdea: 绕着主题玩一下，不直接说破。
learning.memoryHook: allude = play toward a topic.
learning.watchOut: allude to 是固定搭配；不要漏掉介词 to。

definitions.en: a person, group, or country that cooperates with another
to join or unite with another for a purpose

morphemes.note: This is not the adverb suffix -ly.

learning.memoryHook: ally = tied together as partners.
learning.watchOut: ally 作名词重音常在第一音节；作动词可读作 uh-LIE。

definitions.en: high up in the air

learning.memoryHook: aloft = in the loft/air.
learning.watchOut: aloft 是副词，常见于文学或正式描写。

definitions.en: without other people or things
only or exclusively

learning.memoryHook: alone = all one.
learning.watchOut: alone 可作形容词也可作副词；不是动词。

definitions.zh: 远离的；冷淡的；漠不关心的
definitions.en: distant, reserved, or uninvolved

learning.coreIdea: 像船保持在迎风侧一样拉开距离。
learning.memoryHook: aloof = keeping off to one side.
learning.watchOut: aloof 常指人态度冷淡疏离；不要和 aloft “在空中”混。

definitions.en: to change something in some way

learning.coreIdea: 把事物变成“另一种样子”。
learning.memoryHook: alter = make other.
learning.watchOut: alter 通常指局部修改；change 更宽泛。

definitions.en: a change made to something

learning.coreIdea: 变成另一种样子的过程或结果。
learning.memoryHook: alteration = the act/result of altering.
learning.watchOut: alteration 是 alter 的名词，不要和 alternation “交替”混。

definitions.en: happening by turns, one after another
available as another choice or substitute
to happen or do things by turns

learning.memoryHook: alternate = one, then the other.
learning.watchOut: alternate 和 alternative 相近，但 alternate 常强调轮流/备用。

definitions.zh: 交替地；轮流地；隔一个地
definitions.en: one after the other in turn

learning.coreIdea: 以一个接一个轮流的方式。
learning.memoryHook: alternately = in an alternating way.
learning.watchOut: alternately 是“交替地”；alternatively 常是“作为另一选择”。

definitions.en: the act or pattern of happening by turns

learning.coreIdea: 两个状态来回换位的模式。
learning.memoryHook: alternation = the pattern of alternating.
learning.watchOut: alternation 是过程/模式；alternative 是可选项。

definitions.en: available as another possibility or choice
one of two or more possible choices

learning.coreIdea: 在原选项之外的另一个可能。
learning.memoryHook: alternative = the other option.
learning.watchOut: alternative 作名词时常接 to；不要自动当成 alternate 的同义词。

definitions.en: height above sea level or above the ground

learning.memoryHook: competition: com + petit + ion → 竞争，竞赛
learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: involving competition or rivalry

example.en: The market is highly competitive.
example.zh: 这个市场竞争非常激烈。

definitions.en: eager to compete or strong enough to compete well

example.en: She is competitive but fair.
example.zh: 她好胜但公平。

morphemes.meaning: having the nature of, tending to

learning.coreIdea: 具有竞争性质，或有争胜倾向。
learning.memoryHook: competitive = having the nature of compete。
learning.watchOut: competitive 是竞争性的；competent 是胜任的、能力足够的。

definitions.en: the ability to compete successfully

learning.coreIdea: 在竞争中表现强的能力。
learning.memoryHook: competitive + ness.
learning.watchOut: economic competitiveness 常见。

definitions.en: a person, team, or company that competes

example.en: Each competitor presented a different design.
example.zh: 每个参赛者都展示了不同的设计。

learning.coreIdea: 和别人追求同一目标的人、队伍或公司。
learning.memoryHook: competitor = a person or group that competes。
learning.watchOut: competitor 是竞争者；competent 是有能力的。

definitions.en: to collect information and arrange it in a book, list, or program

learning.coreIdea: 把材料汇集整理成一体。
learning.memoryHook: compilare = gather together.
learning.watchOut: compile code 是编译代码。

definitions.en: a feeling of calm self-satisfaction that may ignore danger or flaws

learning.coreIdea: 对自己太满意而放松警惕。

definitions.en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory

definitions.en: to complete or improve something by adding what is missing

learning.coreIdea: 补上缺少部分，使整体完整。
learning.memoryHook: complere = fill up.
learning.watchOut: complement 补足；compliment 赞美，易混。

definitions.en: combining well to complete or improve something

learning.memoryHook: complement + ary.
learning.watchOut: complementary colors/skills。

definitions.en: made of many connected parts and hard to understand

learning.memoryHook: com + plex = folded together.

definitions.en: the state of having many parts and being difficult

learning.watchOut: complexity of a system/problem。

definitions.zh: 并发症；复杂情况；复杂性

learning.watchOut: medical complication 是并发症。

definitions.en: involvement with others in wrongdoing

learning.memoryHook: complicity = being folded together in wrongdoing.

definitions.en: a polite expression of praise, or to praise someone

learning.coreIdea: 礼貌地把赞美补给别人。

learning.watchOut: comply with rules/standards/law。

definitions.en: to form something from parts, or create music or writing

definitions.en: the way parts are arranged, or a piece of writing or music

learning.coreIdea: 放在一起后的结构或作品。
learning.memoryHook: compose -> composition.
learning.watchOut: composition 可指构成，也可指作文/乐曲。

definitions.en: a substance or word made of combined parts

learning.memoryHook: com + ponere = put together.
learning.watchOut: compound word/compound eyes/chemical compound。

definitions.en: eyes made of many small visual units

learning.coreIdea: 由许多小视觉单元组成的眼睛。

learning.watchOut: 昆虫常有 compound eyes。

definitions.en: to understand something fully

definitions.en: able to be understood

definitions.en: the ability or act of understanding

learning.watchOut: reading/listening comprehension 常见。

definitions.en: including nearly everything needed

learning.memoryHook: comprehensive = grasping all.
learning.watchOut: comprehensive review/plan/insurance。

definitions.en: to press something into a smaller space

learning.memoryHook: com + press.
learning.watchOut: compress data/file/gas。

definitions.en: pressed into a smaller space or made more compact

learning.coreIdea: 被压到更小、更紧的状态。
learning.memoryHook: compress + ed.
learning.watchOut: compressed file/data/air 常见。

definitions.en: the process of pressing into a smaller space

learning.coreIdea: 压缩成更小体积的过程。
learning.memoryHook: compress -> compression.
learning.watchOut: data/image/gas compression 常见。

definitions.en: to consist of or include particular parts

definitions.en: Means 妥协，折衷; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

learning.watchOut: 词根拆解按可见学习结构处理；来源不稳定或专名物名保留为底层词根并在 morpheme note 中说明。

definitions.en: required by rule or authority

learning.memoryHook: compel -> compuls- -> compulsory.
learning.watchOut: compulsory education/attendance 常见。

definitions.en: the act or result of calculating

learning.memoryHook: compute -> computation.
learning.watchOut: scientific computation 指科学计算。

definitions.en: to calculate or work out by arithmetic or logic

learning.coreIdea: 把数字放在一起算清楚。
learning.memoryHook: computare = reckon together.
learning.watchOut: 偏正式或技术语境；日常可用 calculate。

definitions.en: curving inward like the inside of a bowl

learning.memoryHook: cav = hollow, as in cave/cavity.
learning.watchOut: 和 convex 凸的 相对。

definitions.en: to hide something or keep it secret

learning.memoryHook: celare = hide.
learning.watchOut: conceal information/evidence/identity 常见。

definitions.en: to admit something is true or yield after resistance

learning.coreIdea: 在争论中退让一步并承认。
learning.memoryHook: cede = go/yield.
learning.watchOut: concede that...；concede defeat。

definitions.en: possible to imagine, believe, or suppose

morphemes.note: The spelling keeps the conceive family visible before -able.

learning.coreIdea: 能够被头脑接纳、想象或认为可能。
learning.memoryHook: conceivable = able to be conceived in the mind。
learning.watchOut: conceivable 是可想象/可能；conceited 是自负；perceivable 是可感知。

definitions.en: to form an idea, plan, image, or possibility in the mind

example.en: The architect conceived a library filled with natural light.
example.zh: 建筑师构想了一座充满自然光的图书馆。

example.en: They had been trying to conceive for several months.
example.zh: 他们已经尝试受孕几个月了。

definitions.en: to understand, imagine, or think of something as possible

example.en: It is hard to conceive of a fair solution without compromise.

morphemes.note: In Latin concipere, con- is often explained as an intensive or together-with prefix.

learning.watchOut: conceive 是构想/受孕；receive 是收到；concept 是已经形成的概念名词。

definitions.en: having the same center

definitions.en: Means 观念，概念; reviewed from the TOEFL source gloss for learner display.

definitions.en: related to ideas rather than physical things

learning.coreIdea: 停留在概念或思想层面的。
learning.memoryHook: concept + ual.
learning.watchOut: conceptual framework/model/art 常见。

definitions.en: a musical performance, or agreement and coordinated action

learning.coreIdea: 多种声音或行动协调到一起。

learning.watchOut: in concert with 表示与……协同。

definitions.en: planned or done together for a shared purpose

learning.memoryHook: concert + ed.
learning.watchOut: concerted effort/action 常见。

learning.watchOut: concerto 是音乐体裁，不是 concert 音乐会本身。

definitions.en: brief but clear, without unnecessary words

learning.coreIdea: 把多余的话切掉，留下清楚重点。
learning.memoryHook: cise = cut.
learning.watchOut: concise 不等于 vague；要短而清楚。

definitions.en: the quality of being brief and clear

learning.memoryHook: concise + ness.
learning.watchOut: 写作评价中常见。

definitions.en: to finish something or decide after reasoning

learning.coreIdea: 把讨论关合起来，得到结果。

definitions.en: proving something clearly and allowing no doubt

learning.coreIdea: 能把争论关闭掉的证据。

learning.watchOut: conclusive evidence/proof 常见。

definitions.en: happening with something else, or something that accompanies it

definitions.en: a hard building material made from cement, sand, stone, and water

learning.memoryHook: concretus = grown together, hardened.
learning.watchOut: concrete idea/evidence 和 concrete material 两个常见义。

definitions.zh: 并发的；同时发生的；一致的
definitions.en: happening at the same time or acting together

learning.memoryHook: con- + currere = run together.
learning.watchOut: concurrent events 同时发生的事件；concurrent powers 共同权力。

definitions.en: to strongly criticize, sentence, or declare something unfit

definitions.en: strong criticism or a judgment of guilt

learning.watchOut: public/international condemnation 常见。

morphemes.meaning: with, together / 共同、一起、加强
make dense, condense / 浓缩；冷凝

learning.memoryHook: condense + -er.
learning.watchOut: technical noun, often in machines, optics, or electronics.

definitions.en: a state, requirement, or circumstance affecting something
to train, influence, or make suitable for a purpose

definitions.zh: 美人鱼；上半身为女子、下半身为鱼尾的传说海中生物
definitions.en: A legendary sea creature imagined with a woman's upper body and a fish tail.

example.en: The old sailors told a story about a mermaid singing near the rocks.
example.zh: 老水手们讲了一个美人鱼在礁石旁歌唱的故事。

morphemes.note: Bound form of older mere 'sea/lake', not modern mere 'only'.

learning.coreIdea: A mermaid is literally a sea-maid: a woman-shaped figure imagined as belonging to the water.
learning.memoryHook: mer- = old 'sea/lake' + maid = young woman.
learning.watchOut: Do not confuse mer- here with modern mere meaning 'only', or with Latin mar-/mare in marine.

definitions.zh: 男性人鱼；上半身为男子、下半身为鱼尾的传说海中生物
definitions.en: A legendary sea creature imagined with a man's upper body and a fish tail.

example.en: The painting shows a merman rising from the waves.
example.zh: 画中有一位男性人鱼从海浪中升起。

learning.coreIdea: A merman is the male counterpart built from the same old water element mer- plus man.
learning.memoryHook: mer- + man = man of the sea.
learning.watchOut: Merman is a counterpart to mermaid, not a derivative form of the word mermaid.

definitions.zh: 人鱼族；性别中性的 merfolk 说法
definitions.en: A gender-neutral term for merfolk, or legendary human-like people of the sea.

example.en: The fantasy novel describes merpeople living below the reef.
example.zh: 那本奇幻小说描写了生活在礁石下方的人鱼族。

learning.coreIdea: Merpeople is a transparent modern compound for people of the sea.
learning.memoryHook: mer- + people = sea people.
learning.watchOut: Merpeople and merfolk overlap; merpeople is often chosen when a gender-neutral wording is wanted.

learning.memoryHook: a pair of pincers = 一把钳子；pinc- 与 pinch 共用夹紧图像。
learning.watchOut: pincers 与 pincer 在同一工具词族页；与 pinch 为同根关联。工具用复数，a pair of pincers 作主语时动词与 pair 一致。

definitions.zh: 捏；夹痛；一撮；困境、经济压力；（英口语）偷拿
definitions.en: to grip or hurt with a small squeeze; a tiny quantity; difficulty or financial pressure; informally, to steal
to press a small area between fingers or two hard surfaces

example.en: Pinch the dough firmly to seal each dumpling.
example.zh: 把面皮捏紧，封好每个饺子的口。

definitions.en: a small amount held between two fingertips

example.en: Stir a pinch of cinnamon into the warm milk.
example.zh: 往温牛奶里搅入一撮肉桂粉。

definitions.en: a difficult situation, especially one caused by limited money or resources

example.en: Small shops are feeling the pinch as rents rise.
example.zh: 随着租金上涨，小店开始感受到经济压力。

definitions.zh: 紧急时；必要时（in a pinch）
definitions.en: an urgent situation in which a substitute may be needed

example.en: In a pinch, a clean jar can serve as a vase.
example.zh: 必要时，干净的罐子可以充当花瓶。

definitions.en: to take something that belongs to someone else

example.en: Someone has pinched my umbrella from the stand.
example.zh: 有人从伞架上偷走了我的伞。

definitions.en: to remove a growing tip with the fingers

example.en: Pinch off the tips to encourage bushier growth.
example.zh: 掐去嫩梢，促使植株长得更茂密。

morphemes.meaning: squeeze between two points / 捏、夹
morphemes.note: 源于中古英语 pinchen 和古法语 pincier；更早来源有争议，不拆成 pin + ch。

learning.coreIdea: 两点夹紧：捏住东西 → 指间的一撮；生活被挤紧 → 困境、拮据。
learning.memoryHook: pinch of salt 是一撮盐；feel the pinch 是感到经济吃紧；pinch pennies 是精打细算。
learning.watchOut: pinch 强调局部夹捏；squeeze 泛指挤压；punch 是挥拳击打。pinched / pinching / pincher 为同页词形；pincer(s) 是法语同源工具词，列在同根关联中。pinch 的更早词源未定；take something with a pinch of salt 表示对某事将信将疑。

definitions.zh: 受夹压的；（面容）消瘦憔悴的；pinch 的过去式和过去分词
definitions.en: compressed or painfully squeezed; looking thin and drawn; also the past tense and past participle of pinch

example.en: His face looked pinched after several sleepless nights.
example.zh: 连续几夜没睡好后，他显得面容憔悴。

definitions.en: past tense of pinch

example.en: I pinched my finger in the drawer.
example.zh: 我的手指被抽屉夹了一下。

morphemes.meaning: squeeze between two points / 捏、夹

morphemes.meaning: past action or resulting state / 过去动作或结果状态

learning.coreIdea: pinch + -ed：被夹紧的状态，延伸为面部像收紧了一样憔悴。
learning.memoryHook: a pinched face = 消瘦憔悴的脸。
learning.watchOut: pinched 可作形容词，也可作过去式或过去分词；-ed 在此读 /t/。

definitions.zh: 捏夹者；夹持物；（复数 pinchers）钳子
definitions.en: a person or thing that pinches; in the plural, an alternative word for pincers

example.en: Keep your fingers away from the crab’s pinchers.
example.zh: 把手指远离螃蟹的螯。

morphemes.meaning: squeeze between two points / 捏、夹

definitions.en: the ongoing action of squeezing a small area, or pressure that hurts

morphemes.meaning: squeeze between two points / 捏、夹
